title: MC-001 partial baseline frozen
content: On 2026-09-25 the official Observatory freeze validator accepted a post-intervention snapshot with 14 captured pairs out of 49 planned and 35 explicitly documented missing pairs. ChatGPT and Gemini produced captured responses; five other systems were blocked by verification or sign-in gates. This is incomplete coverage, not a seven-system comparison; missing runs are not negative results, and no stability, recognition-rate or causal claim follows.

title: OZCU, AIO CODE and VOID MODE hierarchy
content: The canonical first-party project records now define OZCU as the company/venture brand, Marii Cuadros as CEO, AIO CODE as the methodology developed by Marii and applied by OZCU, and VOID MODE as the creative system for artists developed by Marii and applied by OZCU. These are distinct entities. The record does not assert legal incorporation or independent external validation.

title: OZCU public RAG corpus rebuilt
content: The source-only BM25 index was rebuilt from 17 approved public files into 177 passages pinned to GitHub source commit 89f4b65662d97df9c2c4e49138e74b634a66201f. The 24-case internal retrieval suite found all 21 applicable gold sources (21/21). This measures source retrieval only; it does not verify generated-answer correctness or third-party AI recognition.

title: Historical baseline connected to current DEOS architecture
content: AIO CODE is already defined as a Digital Entity Operating System; methodology is an internal historical component. October review connects eight submitted journals, 108 historical images and 14 current captures grouped into 11 episodes. Frozen 14/49 matrix remains unchanged. These are scoped observations, not causal or universal-recognition proof.

title: Phase 2 canonical identity release merged and Vercel production deployed
content: On 2026-10-10 GitHub PR #15 was merged as main commit 277ec5a968bff0c8b39ff85677a75a0531d25dbb. Vercel production deployment dpl_BKtuzsM3YM9MhiheF7AkU8ZxLtd9 reached READY, publishing approved project documentation including the standalone VOID-001 entity page and MC-001 identity alignment. The approved Hugging Face workflow was reported successful by its owner; entity dataset metadata subsequently showed an October 10 update. This first-party deployment record is not evidence of third-party indexing, model recognition, functioning Meta Insights or Journal row visibility. The September 25 entry AIO-JOURNAL-012 reflects an earlier historical classification of AIO CODE as a methodology; its present canonical entity type is DigitalEntityOperatingSystem. Historical rows remain unchanged.
